key_concepts: The main parts of a plant are roots, stem, leaves, flower, and fruit
Roots grow downward into the ground and hold the plant in place
Roots get water and minerals from the soil
The stem holds the plant up and carries water and minerals from roots to leaves
Leaves are green, flat parts that grow from the stem or twig
Flowers are the reproductive part of most plants and are often colorful
Fruits are the ripened ovary of a flower and the product of fertilization
Some plants are fruit-bearing while others are not
Fruits differ in size, shape, color, and number
